reason: Demonstrates 1-bit quantized networks on spin-orbit-torque MRAM in-memory-computing arrays, addressing device variation, IR drop and program-verify overhead at the circuit/device level; it is memory-device research for generic AI accelerators, not an LLM inference system contribution.
title: High-Accuracy, High-Performance In-Memory Computing With High-Resistance Spin-Orbit Torque (SOT) Magnetic Memory
